hero.headline: Furniture for calm, lived-in homes
hero.subline: Sofas, beds, desks, dining tables and everything that finishes a room, made in oak, walnut, linen and wool.

rooms.living: Sofas, coffee tables, rugs and lamps for a living room that invites you to sit down and stay a while.
rooms.dining: Tables, chairs, tableware and lighting for long dinners and relaxed mornings around one surface.
rooms.bedroom: Low beds, linen bedding, soft curtains and bedside lamps for a quiet room built around rest.
rooms.home-office: Desks, chairs, shelving and task light for a workspace you will actually want to sit down in.
rooms.bath: Towels, mats and bath rugs in soft textures and gentle colours for a bathroom that feels like a small retreat.
rooms.kitchen: Cookware and food storage that work hard every day and look good left out on the counter.
rooms.decor: Vases, candle holders, frames, baskets and botanicals: the finishing pieces that make a room yours.

categories.artificial-flora: Stems, arrangements and potted greenery, many in silk or faux, for corners where fresh flowers struggle.
categories.artwork: Quiet prints, canvases and sculptural pieces in soft, natural tones to give a wall or shelf a focal point.
categories.barware: Glassware, tools and trays for a drink at the door or a slow evening in.
categories.bath-mats-rugs: Bath mats and rugs in chenille, cotton, foam and stone-like finishes, in calm, quiet colours.
categories.bath-towels-washcloths: Towels and washcloths, mostly in cotton and linen, in sand, taupe and other gentle colours.
categories.bed-sheets: Sheets, pillowcases and duvet covers in linen, cotton and more, in a palette of quiet neutrals.
categories.beds-bed-frames: Bed frames in oak, walnut and other woods, many low and simple, to anchor a restful bedroom.
categories.candle-holders: Candle holders in wood, marble, bronze and iron for warm, low light at the table or on a shelf.
categories.chandeliers: Chandeliers and pendants in brass, glass, wood and iron to set the overhead layer of light.
categories.clocks: Desk, mantel and wall clocks in wood, stone and brass, made to be looked at as much as read.
categories.coffee-tables: Coffee tables in oak, walnut and ash, from low and wide to compact and rounded.
categories.cookware: Pans, pots and casseroles for everyday cooking, with a few pieces handsome enough to serve from.
categories.curtains-drapes: Linen and cotton curtains, blackout panels and throws to soften windows and filter the light.
categories.desks: Writing desks, modular desks and compact desks in oak, walnut, ash and more for working at home.
categories.dining-chairs: Dining chairs in solid wood, many with linen or upholstered seats, for lingering at the table.
categories.dining-tables: Dining tables in oak, walnut, teak and more, sized for everyday meals and gatherings.
categories.dinnerware: Plates, bowls and serving pieces in stoneware, porcelain and ceramic with soft, earthy glazes.
categories.entertainment-centers-tv-stands: Media consoles, TV stands and sideboards in warm woods that keep the living room in order.
categories.floor-lamps: Floor lamps in wood and brass, including arcs and linen drums, for the middle layer of light.
categories.food-storage: Glass, stoneware and stackable containers that keep the pantry and counter tidy.
categories.household-storage-baskets: Linen, canvas and woven baskets that hide everyday clutter and look good doing it.
categories.mirrors: Round, arched and full-length mirrors in wood and metal frames to borrow light and add depth.
categories.office-chairs: Task and executive chairs in mesh, fabric and leather, with adjustment for long working days.
categories.picture-frames: Frames in oak, walnut, metal and linen to display photographs, prints and keepsakes.
categories.quilts-comforters: Quilts, comforters, duvets and throws for layering a bed through the seasons.
categories.rugs: Wool, cotton, jute and linen rugs and runners to ground a room and soften the floor.
categories.serveware: Boards, bowls, trays and utensils in wood and ceramic for serving from the centre of the table.
categories.shelving: Floating, modular and freestanding shelving in oak, walnut, ash and birch for books and objects.
categories.sofas: Sofas, loveseats and lounge chairs in linen, boucle and more, many on oak or walnut frames.
categories.table-lamps: Table lamps in ceramic, stoneware and wood with linen and fabric shades for warm, low light.
categories.throw-pillows: Cushions and pillows in linen, wool and cotton to add texture to a sofa, chair or bed.
categories.vases: Vases and bud vases in ceramic, porcelain and stoneware for a single stem or an armful.

promises.title: Natural materials
promises.text: Wood, linen, wool, stoneware and brass, chosen to age well.

promises.title: Free delivery over $500
promises.text: Standard delivery is free on orders over $500; otherwise a flat $49.

promises.title: 30-day returns
promises.text: Return unused items within 30 days of delivery for a refund.

promises.title: Assembly available
promises.text: Our team can build your furniture for a flat $79 per item.

newsletter: A short letter from the studio, now and then: new pieces, practical advice for your rooms, and nothing you did not ask for.
footerTagline: Fernhollow. Calm, honest pieces for rooms that are lived in.
